pullRequests.title: fix(archipelago): allow ammo drops for owned out-of-order weapons
pullRequests.author: SavedbyBlood9
pullRequests.head: fix/archipelago-owned-ammo-drops
pullRequests.body:
Archipelago can grant a starting weapon before its normal planet, but ammo selection still reads the retail vendor stock. Add an Ammo_ChooseDrop hook that temporarily supplies a terminated list of owned ammo-supporting weapons, then restores the real stock.
The retail selector still handles assigned first-break ammo, low-ammo priority, pickup count and the Bomb Glove fallback. Add PAL/NTSC selector-spy regression coverage for out-of-order weapons, exclusion of unowned/non-ammo items,…

pullRequests.title: fix(item-randomizer): select ammo from all owned ammo weapons
pullRequests.author: SavedbyBlood9
pullRequests.head: fix/item-randomizer-owned-ammo-drops
pullRequests.body:
RAC1 ammo drops currently borrow the vendor-menu stock, which can omit an owned weapon received before its normal planet. Build the ammo selector's temporary stock directly from all owned ammo-supporting weapons instead, retaining a terminator and restoring the real vendor stock afterward.
Keep the existing rando_on gate so saves outside this seed use the unmodified selector. Delegate assigned first-break ammo, low-ammo priority, pickup count and the Bomb Glove fallback to the retail routine.…
